description: Who the org's flows can email with the "Send email notification" step: team members (userId, opt-out state) and outside addresses (id, status pending/verified/unsubscribed). In that step's `recipients`, use refs: "role:all", "role:admins", "member:<userId>", or "ext:<id>" (verified only). Free-text addresses are not allowed.
name: neuron_list_notify_recipients
title: List Email Notification Recipients
